name: lumped mass
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 将某构件质量集中到有限自由度节点上的等效表示。
usage_note: 该等效ESB模型把支承块及短轨段作集中质量，不等于实际构件无柔性。

complete_examples.text: The blocks are treated as rigid bodies with lumped mass and continuous spacing.
The short-section rail, which is laid on the block, is simulated as a lumped mass with one DOF.
